verdict.what: a brick cottage with a green-tiled roof and a tall chimney
verdict.style: Northern European / Dutch-style brick townhouse, plain vernacular
verdict.summary: A tidy brick box with a stone plinth and dark pilasters, but the green roof sits on top as a flat lid with stepped edges, so it reads as a stacked slab rather than a pitched roof, and the gable ends look like they are not properly closed.
